scenes.say: Everyone gets the same twenty-four hours. Not everyone owns them.
The loop: money buys back time, time goes into leverage, leverage makes more money.
An hour learning a skill or building a system can be worth a week of errands.
The catch: you have to know what your hour is worth, and refuse to sell it cheaper.
Time is the only asset you can't earn back. Price it like one.

takeaway: Time is the only asset you can't earn back. Price it like one.
